new_insert_email_body.title: London Hotel with River Views – May 28-30 request
new_insert_email_body.text:
Hi Emma,

Can you lock in the London hotel before we move ahead with the Paris booking? We need a hotel with River Thames views for 28–30 May. Please search London hotels, check reviews for River Thames mentions, and reserve Riverside View for those dates. Once that’s done, the Paris reservation can follow.

Thanks,
Mark
